B102.name: exec_used
B102.title: Use of exec statement
B102.guidance: Avoid dynamic code execution using exec(). Replace with direct function calls, standard dictionary lookups, or explicit mapping tables.
B102.secure_example: Use dispatcher dictionary instead of exec(code_string)

B307.name: eval_used
B307.title: Use of eval statement
B307.guidance: Avoid evaluating arbitrary strings with eval(). Use ast.literal_eval() for safe literal parsing, or math/json modules.

B602.name: subprocess_popen_with_shell_equals_true
B602.title: Subprocess call with shell=True
B602.guidance: Do not pass shell=True to subprocess calls or os.system(). Pass command arguments as a list with shell=False and sanitize inputs.

B605.name: start_process_with_a_shell
B605.title: Start process with a shell
B605.guidance: Avoid os.system() or shell execution. Use subprocess.run() or subprocess.Popen with argument vectors.

B701.name: jinja2_autoescape_false
B701.title: Jinja2 template rendering without autoescaping
B701.guidance: Enable autoescaping in Jinja2 templates (select_autoescape(['html', 'xml'])) to prevent Cross-Site Scripting (XSS).
